title: Calcein Fluorescence Quenching to Measure Plasma Membrane Water Flux in Live Mammalian Cells
protocol: Prepare calcein-AM loading medium by taking pre-warmed full cell culture medium.
Add probenecid to a final concentration of 1 mM from a 175 mM stock in 200 mM NaOH.
Add calcein-AM to a final concentration of 5 μM from a 5 mM DMSO stock.
Remove all culture medium from cells.
Add 100 μL of calcein-AM loading medium per well.
Return cells to the incubator at 37°C for 90 min.
Switch on the plate reader and set the internal temperature to 37°C.
Wash cells to remove residual calcein-AM after 90 min.
Prepare hypertonic medium for inducing cell shrinkage.
Prepare washing medium by taking pre-warmed HEPES-buffered full cell culture medium and adding probenecid to a final concentration of 1 mM.
Wash cells twice by removing all medium and replacing with 100 μL of washing medium.
On the third wash, replace with 75 μL of washing medium.
Return cells to the incubator for at least 10 min to equilibrate with the new medium.
Prepare hypertonic D-mannitol medium by dissolving D-mannitol powder directly in washing medium to give a final concentration of 400 mM.
Sterilize using a 0.2 μm filter.
Mix D-mannitol to prepare a solution with an osmolality 400 mOsm higher than the mannitol-free washing medium.
Check the D-mannitol concentration using a freezing point depression osmometer.
Prime the plate-reader injector system with hypertonic D-mannitol medium.
Maintain the temperature of the D-mannitol solution at 37°C using a heating block or water bath.
Consider whether D-mannitol is an appropriate non-permeant solute for the cell type and experiment.
If necessary, use alternative solutes such as sucrose if channels like mammalian AQP9 are expressed by the cells of interest.
Use standard culture medium with phenol red for experiments unless concerned about interference at specific wavelengths.
Compare fluorescence intensity between wells in standard medium and phenol red-free medium if needed to ensure negligible impact.
Incubate steps involving probenecid for 90 minutes during calcein loading.
Incubate steps involving probenecid for an additional 10 minutes post-loading equilibration.
Remove cells from the incubator.
Remove the lid from the cell culture plate.
Insert the plate into the pre-warmed plate reader.
Set the plate reader to read each well for 5 s.
Inject 75 μL of hypertonic D-mannitol medium at a speed of 300 μL/s.
Continue reading each well for an additional 50 s with a read interval of 50 ms using bottom optics.
Check for water evaporation from an unlidded plate with culture medium in the plate reader setup.
Leave an unlidded plate with culture medium in the plate reader for the required amount of time (e.g., 88 min).
Visually check medium volume by aspiration into a micropipette tip.
Check osmolality on a freezing point depression osmometer.
